name: Mphasis Ltd.
business_summary: Mid-cap IT services company (Blackstone-controlled, ~40% stake per model knowledge) focused on BFSI (mortgage, banking, insurance), technology and logistics clients, ~80% North America. TTM sales ~Rs16,500 cr, EBITDA 18%, ROE 18.5%, yield 2.5%. Latest quarter in pack is Jun-2026 (Rs4,384 cr, PAT Rs490 cr); Q2 FY27 results not yet captured as of 2026-11-05.
